concerns.text: Phase 0 (Data Availability Check) is not referenced by any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in the spec; it is an extra step not required by the specification.
Phase 8 (Reporting & Figures) produces visual outputs but the spec does not list a corresponding FR or SC for figure generation; this constitutes plan over‑reach.
Phase 9 runs a lint check and contract tests, yet the specification contains no FR or SC that mandates linting or contract verification; this is an additional activity beyond the spec.
Phase 10 (Runtime Guard) adapts runtime if a phase exceeds 5 h, but the spec does not require such a guard; it is an extra safeguard not tied to any FR/SC.
